text:
```yaml
name: Run tests on label

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  run-tests:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'run-tests')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
        env:
          CI: true
```
